title: Day 30 簿記・会計 — 不適切会計、12年ぶりの低水準
description: In fiscal 2025, only 35 listed companies in Japan disclosed improper accounting. That number fell 47.7 percent from the year before. It was the lowest total in 12 years. Of these cases, seven involved actual fraud. In the past, large companies with foreign subsidiaries often caused these problems. This year, however, cases on the Growth market increased instead. The Growth market lists many small, newer companies. So accounting problems are now shifting toward younger firms. This trend surprised many auditors and investors. They had expected fraud to keep rising, not falling.

title: Day 30 簿記・会計 — ASBJが会計基準を同時改正
description: On June 2, 2026, Japan's Accounting Standards Board revised two major accounting rules on the same day. One rule covers financial instruments, and the other covers consolidated financial statements, which are closely related topics. This was not a coincidence, because how a company values its financial instruments can affect its whole group's reported profits. Companies that use Japanese accounting standards must apply these new rules starting soon. Some companies have already begun studying the changes carefully, since the rules are quite technical. Even experienced accountants sometimes find these rules surprisingly difficult to fully understand at first.
